A '''superiority fleet''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] commanded by a [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|fleet admiral]]. It was comprised of two [[Force superiority|force superiorities]], two [[force escort]]s, a [[force technical services]], and a [[force support]], for an average of 390 [[Starship/Legends|starships]] including six [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]].

==History==
The [[Third Ado Superiority Fleet]] patrolled the [[Ado sector/Legends|Ado sector]] under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gor Lequar]].
